title: Massively-Parallel Lossless Data Decompression
relevance: Introduces MRR (Multi-Round Resolution) and DE (Dependency Elimination) for parallel LZ77 decompression on GPUs. Key reference for wavefront-based approach.

title: Practical Parallel Lempel-Ziv Factorization
relevance: Work-efficient parallel LZ77 factorization algorithm with O(log^2 n) depth, demonstrating practical parallel LZ77 processing.

title: Massively Parallel LZ77 Compression and Decompression on the GPU
relevance: Recent GPU implementation of parallel LZ77 compression and decompression with detailed performance analysis.

title: Implementation and Comparison of Parallel LZ77 and LZ78 Algorithms
relevance: Practical comparison of parallel LZ77/LZ78 approaches with cross-platform benchmarks.
